name: Encrypted Letter

angles.text: This encrypted dispatch marks a young rogue's introduction to Jorik Kerridan and the wider underworld, offering early advice on navigating factions like SI:7 and the Defias without losing independence.
Even behind the pious walls of Northshire Abbey, the Kingdom of Stormwind's shadow operatives quietly recruit and train promising agents for the conflicts ahead.

faq.answer: The letter is sealed with the personal insignia of Jorik Kerridan, the rogue trainer stationed in Northshire Valley. It is delivered to promising novices returning from scouting the nearby kobold camps.
Jorik Kerridan keeps a low profile in the quiet stable tucked behind Northshire Abbey. He deliberately stays out of plain sight to avoid drawing unwanted attention to his covert work.

The letter serves as a discreet invitation for rising rogues to introduce themselves to their local trainer. Because rogues trade in secrecy, correspondence is encrypted to keep sensitive training business away from prying eyes around the Abbey.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Letter?

faq.answer: According to Jorik Kerridan, various factions across Azeroth covet the talents of skilled rogues. These include adventuring parties, Stormwind's covert intelligence arm SI:7, and even outlaws like the Defias Brotherhood who seek spies inside Stormwind.
faq.q: Which organizations are looking to recruit rogues?

faq.answer: Jorik urges you to remain your own person and never let powerful groups bully you into working against your will. He reminds rogues that they hold the cards before the game is done, emphasizing independence and caution.
faq.q: What advice does Jorik Kerridan give?

faq.answer: Jorik prefers the secluded stables behind Northshire Abbey because the spot is nice, quiet, and draws very little attention. Covert trainers and operatives prefer to meet without being noticed by the Abbey's clergy or guards.
faq.q: Why does Jorik Kerridan stay in the stable?

sections.body: Behind the tranquil and pious exterior of Northshire Abbey, covert talents are quietly recruited and honed. The Encrypted Letter is handed to promising novices after dealing with the encroaching kobold vermin, bearing the seal of Jorik Kerridan. Addressed discreetly to keep matters away from the inquisitive gaze of priests and paladins, the dispatch directs its bearer to a secluded rendezvous in the stables behind the Abbey.
sections.title: A Discreet Summons

sections.body: Jorik Kerridan stays in the stables precisely because it is quiet and draws little scrutiny. Welcoming newcomers who arrive unnoticed, he wastes no time explaining the harsh reality awaiting thieves and scouts in the wider world. Powerful organizations—from Stormwind's royal intelligence agency SI:7 to the rebellious Defias Brotherhood—constantly seek stealthy operatives. Jorik counsels personal autonomy above all else, warning novices never to be pushed around by powerful syndicates and reminding them that a clever rogue holds all the cards.
sections.title: Shadows in Northshire

summary: The Encrypted Letter is a covert summons delivered to promising rogues at Northshire Abbey, sealed with the insignia of Jorik Kerridan. It introduces new operatives to their trainer in the secluded stables, providing early counsel on surviving the dangerous interests of organizations like SI:7 and the Defias Brotherhood.
